purpose: Prove human approval boundaries locally: one candidate Work Item per high-risk class (decision, delegation, risk, sensitive, outbound, memory promotion, skill authority expansion, tenant-affecting) stays proposed with approvalRequired and a no-pre-approval-external-action guard until explicitly approved; one approved Work Item carries an approval record whose declared scope authorizes only the proposed-to-approved state transition, while a second desired action on the same item (delegation) is shown as requiring a separate approval via a deferred entry. Approval events are receipt-backed (CR-LOCAL-*, manifest verbs, actor = human/Doug, authority basis). Receipts here are local contract evidence only, and every live mutation or external action stays receipt-gated and deferred.

candidateWorkItems.com_title: Decision requiring human approval before it may be acted on
candidateWorkItems.com_summary: A governance decision extracted from a manual summary source. It must stay proposed until Doug explicitly approves it; no external action, delegation, or memory promotion may occur pre-approval.
candidateWorkItems.com_rationale: Decisions are a high-risk class: acting on a decision without explicit human approval would bypass the Council's judgment gate. This candidate stays proposed and approval-required.
candidateWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the decision rationale and either approves the proposed-to-approved transition or holds/blocks it.
candidateWorkItems.externalActionGuard: No external action, tenant write, outbound send, delegation, memory promotion, skill authority expansion, or state transition occurred before explicit human approval; this decision candidate stays proposed and receipt-gated.

candidateWorkItems.com_title: Delegation requiring human approval before a Minion may act
candidateWorkItems.com_summary: A delegation extracted from a manual summary source. Delegating authority to a Minion is high-risk and must stay proposed until Doug explicitly approves the delegation scope.
candidateWorkItems.com_rationale: Delegation grants a Minion authority to act on the human's behalf, so it requires explicit human approval of the declared delegation scope before any Minion action.
candidateWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the delegation target and scope, then approves only that scope or declines.
candidateWorkItems.externalActionGuard: No Minion was granted authority, no delegated action executed, and no outbound action occurred before explicit human approval; this delegation candidate stays proposed and receipt-gated.

candidateWorkItems.com_title: Risk item requiring human approval before mitigation or escalation
candidateWorkItems.com_summary: A delivery risk surfaced from a meeting note source. Acting on the risk (mitigation or escalation) is high-risk and must stay proposed until Doug explicitly approves the response.
candidateWorkItems.com_rationale: Risks may require outbound escalation or commitment changes, so the risk response is a high-risk class requiring explicit human approval before any mitigation or escalation action.
candidateWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the risk and approves a specific mitigation or escalation scope, or holds it.
candidateWorkItems.externalActionGuard: No mitigation, escalation, outbound notification, or state transition occurred before explicit human approval; this risk candidate stays proposed and receipt-gated.

candidateWorkItems.com_title: Sensitive handling item requiring human approval before any action
candidateWorkItems.com_summary: A sensitive-handling request extracted from a meeting note source. Sensitive items may involve confidential or restricted data and must stay proposed until Doug explicitly approves the handling action.
candidateWorkItems.com_rationale: Sensitive handling is a high-risk class because the underlying content may carry confidentiality or retention constraints; no handling action may occur before explicit human approval.
candidateWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the sensitivity context and approves a specific handling action, or holds it.
candidateWorkItems.externalActionGuard: No sensitive content was handled, copied, forwarded, or otherwise acted on before explicit human approval; this sensitive candidate stays proposed and receipt-gated.

candidateWorkItems.com_title: Outbound action requiring human approval before any external send
candidateWorkItems.com_summary: An outbound action (e.g., sending a message or making an external call) extracted from a mock Outlook message reference. Outbound action is high-risk and must stay proposed until Doug explicitly approves the specific external action.
candidateWorkItems.com_rationale: Outbound action reaches an external system or recipient, so it is a high-risk class requiring explicit human approval of the specific send before any external action is requested or completed.
candidateWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the outbound payload and recipient and approves the specific external action, or declines.
candidateWorkItems.externalActionGuard: No message was sent, no external system was called, and no external_action_requested or external_action_completed receipt was emitted before explicit human approval; this outbound candidate stays proposed and receipt-gated.

candidateWorkItems.com_title: Memory promotion requiring human approval before a memory candidate is promoted
candidateWorkItems.com_summary: A memory candidate extracted from a manual summary source that is proposed for promotion to approved instruction memory. Memory promotion is high-risk and must stay proposed until Doug explicitly approves the promotion scope.
candidateWorkItems.com_rationale: Promoting a memory candidate to an approved instruction changes future Minion behavior, so memory promotion is a high-risk class requiring explicit human approval of the promotion scope before any memory_promoted receipt is emitted.
candidateWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the memory candidate scope and recall-use policy and approves the promotion, or rejects it.
candidateWorkItems.externalActionGuard: No memory candidate was promoted, no approved instruction was created, and no memory_promoted receipt was emitted before explicit human approval; this memory promotion candidate stays proposed and receipt-gated.

candidateWorkItems.com_title: Skill authority expansion requiring human approval before a skill is broadened
candidateWorkItems.com_summary: A proposed expansion of a Council Skill's authority class or allowed context, extracted from a manual summary source. Skill authority expansion is high-risk and must stay proposed until Doug explicitly approves the expansion scope.
candidateWorkItems.com_rationale: Expanding a skill's authority class broadens what a Minion may do autonomously, so skill authority expansion is a high-risk class requiring explicit human approval of the expansion scope before any skill record is updated.
candidateWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the proposed authority expansion and approves only the declared scope, or declines.
candidateWorkItems.externalActionGuard: No skill authority class was broadened, no allowed context was expanded, and no skill record was updated before explicit human approval; this skill authority expansion candidate stays proposed and receipt-gated.

candidateWorkItems.com_title: Tenant-affecting change requiring human approval before any tenant mutation
candidateWorkItems.com_summary: A tenant-affecting change request extracted from a meeting note source (e.g., a Dataverse solution or environment configuration change). Tenant-affecting action is high-risk and must stay proposed until Doug explicitly approves the specific tenant change.
candidateWorkItems.com_rationale: Tenant-affecting changes mutate the live Dataverse environment or its configuration, so they are a high-risk class requiring explicit human approval of the specific change before any tenant write is performed.
candidateWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: Doug reviews the tenant-affecting change and approves only the specific declared change, or declines.
candidateWorkItems.externalActionGuard: No tenant write, solution publish, environment configuration change, or other tenant-affecting mutation occurred before explicit human approval; this tenant-affecting candidate stays proposed and receipt-gated.

approvedWorkItems.com_title: Approve decision to adopt the com publisher prefix convention
approvedWorkItems.com_summary: A decision item that Doug explicitly approved, moving it from proposed to approved. The approval authorizes only that state transition; delegating the decision to a Minion for execution is a separate action requiring its own approval.
approvedWorkItems.com_rationale: The decision to adopt the com publisher prefix convention was proposed from a manual summary source and required explicit human approval before it could be considered actionable Council work.
approvedWorkItems.com_recommended_next_action: If Doug wants a Minion to execute this decision, a separate delegation approval with its own declared scope is required; the current approval does not authorize delegation or execution.
approvedWorkItems.externalActionGuard: No external action, tenant write, outbound send, delegation, memory promotion, skill authority expansion, or execution occurred before the explicit human approval that moved this item from proposed to approved; the approval authorizes only that state transition.

approvalRecord.approvedScope: Authorize the com_state_group transition proposed to approved for CWI-LOCAL-APPROVAL-SCOPE-001 only. This approval does NOT authorize delegation of this decision to a Minion, any outbound or external action, memory promotion, skill authority expansion, or any tenant write.
approvalRecord.authorityBasis: Doug explicit human approval of this decision item's state transition only
outOfScopeActions: delegate this decision to a Minion for execution
promote this decision to approved instruction memory

deferredActions.deferredAction: Delegate this approved decision to a Minion for execution
deferredActions.rationale: Delegation is a distinct high-risk action. The approval of CWI-LOCAL-APPROVAL-SCOPE-001 authorized only the proposed-to-approved state transition; it did not authorize delegation. A separate approval receipt with its own declared scope is required before a Minion may be granted authority to execute this decision.

receipts.com_decision_rationale: Doug proposed this decision item from a manual summary source; it stayed proposed and approval-required until explicitly approved.

receipts.com_decision_rationale: Doug approved the proposed-to-approved state transition for this decision item only. The second desired action (delegation) is recorded as a deferred entry requiring a separate approval receipt.
